_comment: Durable, hand-maintained editorial descriptions keyed by dataset/model short name (not the full org/name id). Mirrors the sapinsapin-web repo's own catalog.js pattern: prose here rarely changes; counts/licenses/dates are volatile and come from knowledge/snapshots/current-public-state.json instead. If the generator finds an asset in the snapshot with no entry here, it falls back to a generic 'not yet described here' line rather than inventing content — same honesty policy the live site itself uses for newly-published repos.

datasets.pld: Prompted 16 kHz speech, the flagship collection, recorded across nine Philippine languages plus English.
datasets.filipinospeechcorpus: The Filipino Speech Corpus (Sagum) as segment-level 16 kHz audio — mostly isolated word tokens rather than full sentences.
datasets.kumu-livestream-segmented: Taglish code-switched livestream speech, segmented for ASR/TTS research.
datasets.BantayWika: A FineWeb-compatible pretraining text corpus derived from UP Sentro ng Wikang Filipino and the UP-DSP Bantay-Wika collection.
datasets.halohalo: A combined FineWeb-compatible web corpus merging the cleaned halo-tgl, halo-hil, and halo-bcl corpora.
datasets.halo-tgl: A cleaned web-scraped Tagalog text corpus for LLM pretraining.
datasets.halo-hil: A cleaned web-scraped Hiligaynon text corpus for LLM pretraining.
datasets.halo-bcl: A cleaned web-scraped Bikol text corpus for LLM pretraining.

model_family_notes.text-generation: Continually-pretrained or fine-tuned large language models adapted to Filipino/Philippine-language text (e.g. Llama 3.1 and gpt-oss checkpoints continued on Filipino news text, plus a Bikol-focused fine-tune).
model_family_notes.unspecified: Additional generation/vision-language checkpoints not yet tagged with a Hub pipeline type — check the specific model card for its actual task.
model_family_notes.text-to-speech: SpeechT5-based text-to-speech fine-tunes, mostly one model per Philippine language trained on the PLD dataset, plus a Filipino Speech Corpus fine-tune with a browser-deployable ONNX export.
model_family_notes.automatic-speech-recognition: Whisper- and OmniASR-based speech-recognition fine-tunes, mostly one model per Philippine language trained on the PLD dataset, plus Filipino Speech Corpus fine-tunes with browser-deployable ONNX exports.
model_family_notes.audio-to-audio: Voice-conversion models that re-speak existing audio in a different voice while preserving words and timing.
